run_VGGSfM_pipeline: run the VGGSfM pipeline on a set of input images for sparse and dense reconstruction
build_VGGSfM_model: build the VGGSfM model and load checkpoint weights for camera, track, and triangulation predictors
sparse_reconstruct_images: perform sparse reconstruction on input images including camera pose estimation and 3D point triangulation
dense_reconstruct_predictions: perform dense reconstruction by predicting and aligning monocular depth maps with sparse SfM points
visualize_3D_reconstruction: visualize the 3D point cloud and camera positions in Visdom or Gradio
